name: Suspicious Golden-Tempered Jade
desc: A chicken dish native to Liyue. Its skin is a tantalizing bright yellow, beautifully contrasting with the pale, tender-looking meat beneath. Yet the moment you take a bite, regret sets in — the meat is dry and tough, wedging itself stubbornly between your teeth...

value.text: Restores 18% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 300 HP every 5s for 30s.
